editorial:
Imagine getting out of prison only to be shot and left for dead immediately. That is exactly what happens to Eddie Franks, a man who just wants to start over but finds himself fighting for his life instead. You will feel the tension as Eddie tries to heal from his injuries while keeping his daughter safe from the people who tried to kill him. It is a gritty ride through the streets of London where nobody can be trusted, and the vibe feels like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse. You get a great mix of family drama and street warfare that keeps you wondering who the real bad guy is.

The action scenes are punchy and the twists actually make sense, though some of the middle parts drag a bit. The acting is top-notch, making you really root for Eddie even though he has a dark past. If you love crime stories with lots of betrayal, you need to see this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail in the city shots, or just grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you are a movie buff.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, you find out that Eddie's own brother was the one who ordered the hit to take over the family business. Eddie manages to outsmart his brother in a rainy alley fight, protecting his daughter one last time. After the brother is arrested, Eddie decides to leave London for good. He takes his daughter and disappears to start a quiet life, finally breaking the cycle of crime and violence.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories and gritty crime thrillers.
